questions.stem: Which of the following is a reason why digital thermometers are preferred over mercury thermometers?
choices: They are more expensive
They are easier to read and safer
They measure temperature more quickly
They require less maintenance
questions.solution: Digital thermometers are preferred because they are easier to read and safer. Mercury is toxic, so digital thermometers eliminate the risk of exposure to mercury if the thermometer breaks. They are not necessarily more expensive, do not measure temperature more slowly, and do not require more maintenance.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a correct statement about a laboratory thermometer?
choices: It is used to measure body temperature
It has a range of –10 °C to 110 °C
It can be used to measure the temperature of boiling water and is calibrated for that purpose
It is designed to measure the temperature of the human body
questions.solution: A laboratory thermometer typically has a range from –10 °C to 110 °C, which allows it to measure a wide variety of temperatures in experiments. It is not designed for body temperature, which requires a clinical thermometer with a narrower range. Measuring boiling water is possible but not its primary purpose. The range is a defining characteristic of a laboratory thermometer.

questions.stem: A clinical thermometer is used to measure body temperature. Which of the following is a correct precaution to take while using it?
choices: Wipe the tip of the thermometer with a wet cloth after use
Place the thermometer in the armpit without closing the mouth
Reset the thermometer before measuring a new temperature
Hold the thermometer by the tip to get an accurate reading
questions.solution: The correct precaution is to reset the thermometer before measuring a new temperature. This ensures the reading starts from zero and is accurate. Wiping the tip with a wet cloth may damage the thermometer, placing it in the armpit without closing the mouth can lead to inaccurate readings, and holding it by the tip may affect the sensor's accuracy.

questions.stem: Which of the following statements is true about the normal body temperature?
choices: It is exactly 37°C for every person
It is the same for all humans regardless of age
It is the average of body temperatures of a large number of people
It is measured using the Fahrenheit scale only
questions.solution: The normal body temperature is the average of body temperatures of a large number of people. It is not exactly 37°C for every person, nor is it the same for all humans. It can be measured using both Celsius and Fahrenheit scales.

questions.stem: If the temperature of a liquid is 37 °C, what is its temperature in Kelvin?
questions.solution: To convert Celsius to Kelvin, you add 273.15 to the Celsius temperature. Therefore, 37 °C + 273.15 equals 310.15 K. The option 273.15 K is the Kelvin equivalent of 0 °C, 370.15 K incorrectly adds 333.15, and 100.15 K incorrectly adds only 63.15.

hi.stem: यदि एक द्रव का तापमान 37 °C है, तो इसका तापमान केल्विन में क्या होगा?
hi.solution: सेल्सियस को केल्विन में बदलने के लिए, आप सेल्सियस तापमान में 273.15 जोड़ते हैं। अतः 37 °C + 273.15 बराबर 310.15 K होता है। 273.15 K शून्य °C के केल्विन तुल्यांक है, 370.15 K गलती से 333.15 जोड़ देता है, और 100.15 K गलती से केवल 63.15 जोड़ देता है।

questions.stem: If the temperature of a substance increases by 2 °C, what is the heat change in J if the mass is 82 g and the specific heat capacity is 3.5 J/(g K)?
questions.solution: The heat change can be calculated using the formula: Q = m × c × ΔT. Here, m = 82 g, c = 3.5 J/(g K), and ΔT = 2 °C. So, Q = 82 × 3.5 × 2 = 574 J. The correct answer is 574 J.

hi.stem: यदि किसी पदार्थ के तापमान में 2 °C की वृद्धि होती है, तो जैसे द्रव्यमान 82 ग्राम है और विशिष्ट ऊष्मा क्षमता 3.5 J/(g K) है, तो ऊष्मा परिवर्तन J में क्या होगा?
hi.solution: ऊष्मा परिवर्तन की गणना सूत्र Q = m × c × ΔT द्वारा की जा सकती है। यहां, m = 82 ग्राम, c = 3.5 J/(g K), और ΔT = 2 °C। इसलिए, Q = 82 × 3.5 × 2 = 574 J। सही उत्तर 574 J है।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation is accurate, maintains the same meaning, and uses appropriate technical terms common in Hindi science textbooks.

questions.stem: In an experiment, a student measures the temperature of boiling water using a clinical thermometer. What will happen?
choices: The thermometer will break
The temperature will be measured accurately
The reading will be lower than the actual temperature
The reading will be higher than the actual temperature
questions.solution: A clinical thermometer is designed for measuring body temperature, which is much lower than the temperature of boiling water. Using it for boiling water would cause it to break because the mercury or liquid inside would expand beyond the thermometer's capacity. The other options are incorrect because the thermometer would not provide an accurate reading or a reading that is either higher or lower than the actual temperature; it would simply fail.

questions.stem: Why is the temperature of the core of the Sun much higher than the temperature of the planets in the Solar System?

The Sun has a nuclear fusion process
The planets are farther from the Sun
The planets reflect sunlight
questions.solution: The core of the Sun has a temperature of 15 million degrees Celsius due to nuclear fusion, which is the process by which the Sun generates energy. The correct answer is that the Sun has a nuclear fusion process.
